messages:
Maria (CS Ops): Heads up — tonight we saw a spike of duplicate enablement feedback rows hitting CRM from the LMS webhook. ~220 dupes in the last 2 hours, mostly same external_id. Logs attached.
Devon (Enablement): ugh. sample external_id?
Maria (CS Ops): example: ext_2026-03-22_9a7f3c. Payloads look identical except webhook attempt_id. snippet:
```
INFO 2026-03-22T21:03:12Z webhook received ext_id=ext_2026-03-22_9a7f3c attempt_id=42 payload_hash=0x5a7c
INFO 2026-03-22T21:03:12Z webhook processed -> created feedback id=fb_9912
INFO 2026-03-22T21:03:14Z webhook received ext_id=ext_2026-03-22_9a7f3c attempt_id=43 payload_hash=0x5a7c
INFO 2026-03-22T21:03:14Z webhook processed -> created feedback id=fb_9913
```
Ash (CS Tools): Looks like the LMS retries are creating new records because we index on CRM's generated id instead of vendor external_id + hash. Quick fix: treat external_id + payload_hash as idempotency key so duplicate attempts upsert instead of insert.
Devon (Enablement): that'd be great — if we can avoid duplicate nudges to customers. Can we also add a playbook debounce to avoid sending email if feedback was created <5m ago?
Ash (CS Tools): Proposed roll:
- infra change: webhook handler uses `ON CONFLICT (external_id, payload_hash) DO NOTHING` (or upsert) at DB layer
- playbook rule: if feedback_count(external_id, last_10m) > 0 skip outbound nudges
- dry-run: mark duplicates with tag `dupe_candidate` for 24h before auto-deleting
SQL quick check for dupes (dry-run):
```
SELECT external_id, payload_hash, count(*) c
FROM feedback
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY external_id, payload_hash
HAVING count(*) > 1
LIMIT 50;
```
Leo (SRE): DB-level upsert is safest for live traffic. If we do a new unique index on (external_id, payload_hash) we need to backfill existing dupes first or the migration will fail.
Maria (CS Ops): ack. Backfill plan suggestion: run the SELECT above, tag duplicates, run dedupe script to merge into earliest record and keep references. Then apply unique index in maintenance window.
Ash (CS Tools): I can draft the dedupe script. Merging rule: keep oldest created_at as canonical, reassign any foreign keys (player_notes, playbook_runs) to canonical id, then delete others. Dry-run flag respected.
Devon (Enablement): For playbook changes, I can add the debounce condition to the nudge workflow and toggle via feature flag. Test with cohort A/B.
playbook-bot: New playbook draft created: `feedback-debounce-v1` (creator: Devon). Link: https://console.redwood/playbooks/feedback-debounce-v1
Leo (SRE): timeline? DB change + index needs a low-traffic window. Suggest Saturday 02:00 UTC maintenance. Ash, can you estimate runtime?
Ash (CS Tools): Backfill tagging pass should be <30m for the week range on current cluster. Merge script depends on FK counts but estimate 1-2 hours worst-case. I'll add a preflight that fails safe.
Maria (CS Ops): Ok schedule tentative for Sat 02:00 UTC. Devon will enable playbook flag in canary 1h earlier. Ash will prepare migration and dry-run script tomorrow. Leo to be on-call for rollback. :thumbsup:
Devon (Enablement): I'll create the canary cohort and mock payloads to validate no duplicate nudges.
Maria (CS Ops): Thanks all — please drop any sample dupes you find into this thread and tag `dupe_candidate`. I'll compile a short incident note after the patch. :eyes:
notes: Thread about duplicate enablement feedback from LMS webhook; proposed DB upsert + playbook debounce + backfill/merge plan. Short, operational coordination between CS, Enablement, CS Tools, and SRE.
